# PSNA Emphatic Fine Arts

> Vocal, keyboard, guitar, drums, tabla, Bharatanatyam, yoga and drawing — graded classes for kids and adults, in Pondy Bazaar or online.

## Frequently asked questions

### Where is PSNA Emphatic Fine Arts?
Kosala Flats A4, 2nd Floor, Srinivasa Road, Pondy Bazaar, T. Nagar, Chennai 600 017.

### What facilities does PSNA Emphatic Fine Arts have?
Vocal, Keyboard, Piano, Guitar, Drums, Tabla, Mridangam, Bharatanatyam, Yoga, Drawing & painting, 8-grade certification, Online classes, Weekend & part-time batches.

### Do you offer certification?
Yes. We follow an 8-grade system with systematic examinations and certification.

### Can I learn online?
Yes — classes are available both offline at Pondy Bazaar and online.

### How do I join PSNA Emphatic Fine Arts?
Pick a date on this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 95000 02733.
